summary: Ponce Financial Group filed an 8-K reporting results of its June 11, 2026 annual meeting. Stockholders elected three directors, ratified Forvis Mazars as auditor, and approved say-on-pay compensation on a non-binding basis. The filing also includes CEO remarks furnished as an exhibit. No unusual or material special-situation event is disclosed; the report reflects routine corporate governance and annual meeting disclosures. No special situation category applies.
